description: Defines the class lcid_ul_sch_t representing logical channel identifiers for UL-SCH in 3GPP LTE, including enums, methods for validation, and formatting support.

classes.name: ocudu::lcid_ul_sch_t
classes.description: Represents UL-SCH logical channel IDs with methods for validation, type conversion, and size determination.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns a new value to the lcid_ul_sch_t object with validation.

methods.name: operator underlying_type()
methods.description: Converts lcid_ul_sch_t to its underlying integer type.

methods.name: value()
methods.description: Returns the underlying integer value of the LCID.

methods.name: is_ccch()
methods.description: Checks if the LCID belongs to CCCH.

methods.name: is_ce()
methods.description: Checks if the LCID is an MAC Control Element.

methods.name: is_sdu()
methods.description: Checks if the LCID belongs to a Radio Bearer Logical Channel.

methods.name: is_valid_lcid()
methods.description: Validates if the LCID is within acceptable range and not reserved.

methods.name: has_length_field()
methods.description: Determines if the LCID subPDU has an associated length field.

methods.name: is_var_len_ce()
methods.description: Checks if the LCID is a variable length Control Element.

methods.name: sizeof_ce()
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the control element associated with the LCID.
